ledger: shot 1: 00:00-00:07 — frontal medium close-up; man in green/white striped shirt, center frame, facing camera and speaking; anchors: wood door with mounted dartboard and blue coat on wall hook (screen-left), framed print and light-switch plate (screen-right)
transition: ~00:07-00:08 — cross-dissolve; outgoing frontal shot superimposed over incoming rear-view shot of the same man mid-turn

shot 2: 00:08-00:09 — rear medium view; same man (identical green/white striped shirt, chest pocket matches) walking away from camera toward a wood door with a wreath; dartboard/coat-hook wall no longer in frame

person A (man, striped shirt): sole person, present in every shot; placement relative to room consistent with a continuous turn-and-exit across the dissolve; no second person, no duplicate, no geometry overlap observed

findings.description: Frontal close-up from 00:00-00:07 clearly shows the man wearing no glasses (eyes and temples unobstructed). At the dissolve (~00:08), the incoming rear-profile view shows a thin glasses temple arm at his ear as he walks away, and it remains in the 00:09 frame. No shot shows him putting glasses on. Because the dissolve reads as a continuous turn-and-exit (same shirt, same room, no implied relocation or significant elapsed time), the sudden appearance of eyewear is unexplained.
